title: Overhang crop re-encodes a JPEG: extract the in-bounds part, then extend, in one pipeline
description: cropExtended pads through a toBuffer() intermediate in the INPUT format, so an overhang crop of a JPEG passes through an extra q80 encode (up to 96/channel off). Extract the intersection, then extend by the overhang, in one sharp pipeline: no intermediate, no 16K memory spike.
